svg.title: Sangan — reconstructed GOAT 2005 text overlay
svg.desc: Historical Card Errata: https://www.goatformat.com/rulings7.html. Original art, border, type line and statistics retained.

text.font-family: Times New Roman, Liberation Serif, serif
text.tspan: When this card is sent from the field to the Graveyard, select 1
monster with an ATK of 1500 or less from your Deck, show it to
your opponent, and add it to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck.
